title: fix(console): a related list keyed by a parent lookup no longer blanks the record page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEGV1HQmig3DjX5wFS9Dwpx)_

Closes #33609

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#2` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5ogAAW3KBKDyrAs5C7` · claim 6892483975, amendment 6892596732

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录详情页一次请求（`/page`）不再带上「按父记录的非 id 字段关联」的相关列表（例如订单的 `selected_plan` 关联的方案明细），这类列表改为自己单独读取；同时这类列表按父记录查找字段的存储 id 过滤，而不是按展开后的整条记录。
- 为什么改：这种页面配置合法（`os validate` 通过），但一次请求接口只认「子记录字段存的是本记录 id」的列表，遇到别的就整单 400，整个页面显示「无法加载此记录」；下游 CRM 的订单页正中此问题（#33609）。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台两个文件，服务端接口与 spec 均未动；按 id 关联的列表照旧随一次请求返回。代价是这类列表多一次独立读取。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPagePayload.ts（`pageAnswersRelatedList`，复用计数预取的同一规则）、ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx（`parentLinkValue` 折回存储 id）。
- 两分钟验证：在订单页放一个 `relationshipValueField: 'selected_plan'` 的方案明细列表，打开任一订单：页面正常显示，明细列表列出该方案的行；网络面板里 `/page` 请求不含该列表，另有一条按方案 id 过滤的读取。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The fold-in** (measured on origin/main a557fa38): `recordPageRelatedLists` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPagePayload.ts`, the `record:related_list` branch of `visit`) added every list with `objectName` + `relationshipField` to the one-request `POST /data/{object}/{id}/page`, dropping `relationshipValueField`. The route's contract (`RecordPageRelatedRequestSchema`, strict) is "the child records whose field holds this record's id", so a list keyed by another parent field made it refuse the whole request (400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `invalid_relationship`) and the page drew `record-load-failed`.
- **Fix 1, `recordPagePayload.ts`.** A list now rides the request only when `pageAnswersRelatedList` says so. That is the count prefetch's own rule (`relatedCountTargetOf` in plugin-detail `useRelatedCounts.ts`), not a second copy: plugin-detail's package index does not export `relatedCountTargetOf`, so it is reached through the exported `relatedCountTargetsIn`, handed the one node as a bare `{ type, properties }` with its child slots left out, so the walk answers for that node alone. No published export changes. A list it leaves out reads for itself through its block, as before the one-request page. The module docblock's "what the page cannot name" list names it.
- **Accepted deviation (seat, amendment 6892596732).** Reusing the rule whole also leaves a list bound to a `dataSource` or `parentDataSource` of its own out of `/page`; those read for themselves, as the count prefetch already treats them. Pinned.
- **Fix 2, `record-related-list.tsx`** (claim amendment 6892596732). With fix 1 alone the page renders, but the card's list still drew "Couldn't load records": the record page (and a `parentDataSource` parent) reads the parent with every relation `$expand`ed, and `parentLinkValue` read `ctx.data[relationshipValueField]` raw, so the list filtered `allocation_plan` by the expanded `{ id, name }` (client refusal `INVALID_FILTER`, "Unknown filter operator 'id' for field 'allocation_plan'", no GET sent). The value is now collapsed through core's one rule for a relation's stored value, `toPredicateRecord`, over the parent's field definitions (`ctx.objectSchema.fields`, which both the record page and `ParentRecordBinding` provide). A non-relation value field (`name`, `record_id`) passes through unchanged. The read stays un-cast on `schema.relationshipValueField` (the objectui#9475 pin is green).
- Not changed (order ⛔): no `packages/spec/**`, no `packages/rest/**` route change, no `os validate` refusal.
- Changeset `.changeset/33609-related-list-parent-lookup-page.md`: `@object-ui/console` (its `dist` ships the private app-shell) and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `patch`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.nonIdKeyedRelatedList-33609.test.tsx`:
  - rendered: the real `RecordDetailView` over the real `ObjectStackAdapter`, StrictMode, an authored page with the card's shape (order `selected_plan` → plan lines, `relationshipValueField: 'selected_plan'`) beside an id-keyed task list. The transport answers `/page` as the route does (a related entry whose field does not reference the page object refuses the whole request 400 `invalid_relationship`) and serves the page record with `selected_plan` expanded. Pins: no `record-load-failed`, the record drawn; one `/page` request naming only the id-keyed list; the task row drawn; a GET of the plan lines filtered `["allocation_plan","=","plan-7"]` and none carrying `[object Object]`; both plan lines drawn.
  - builder: `recordPageRelatedLists` leaves out a `relationshipValueField: 'selected_plan'` list and keeps an id-keyed one and an explicit `'id'` one; leaves out `dataSource`- and `parentDataSource`-bound lists (the accepted deviation); keeps an id-keyed list under `visibleWhen` (as today).
- Red first on origin/main a557fa38 (the rendered pin): `record-load-failed` drawn with `VALIDATION_FAILED` "Invalid record page request".
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix (ui vitest aliases `@object-ui/plugin-detail` to `src`, no rebuild), marker counted on disk, each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - fix 1 bypassed (`String('ABL33609').length > 0 ||` before the rule): 3 failed / 1 passed (the rendered pin and both leave-out builder pins; the visibleWhen keep pin stays green, as it should);
  - fix 2 reverted to the raw `ctx.data` read: 1 failed / 3 passed (the rendered pin: no GET with the plan id).

## Acceptance notes

- Reach is wider than the card, by reading (not measured live): `plugin-sharing` `sys-queue.page.ts` (`relationshipValueField: 'name'`) and `plugin-audit` `sys-audit-log.page.ts` (`'record_id'`) declare non-id-keyed lists on shipped platform pages; fix 1 keeps them out of `/page` the same way.
- Cost: one extra GET per such list on open (the pre-one-request shape), for a rare shape.
- Follow-up, not done here (order: name it, do not do it): any OTHER 400 from `/page` still blanks the whole page. A cheap local degrade would be for `RecordDetailView` to treat a `VALIDATION_FAILED` on the payload as "no payload" and let each reader read for itself, as an adapter without `getRecordPage` does.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0 (after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure).
- ESLint `--no-inline-config` on the three changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors (warnings only: `no-explicit-any`, the changed `parentLinkValue` line keeps the base line's one `as any`). `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (from `ui/`): 0 new citations, exit 0.

The full app-shell suite and the rest of the farm are CI's.
- `origin/main` moved 11 commits past base a557fa38; none touches a changed file, `useRelatedCounts.ts`, `RecordDetailView.tsx` or core's `predicate-record.ts`.
